title: Will only work for a short time
text:
Will only work for a short time. One word: Garbage

This lasted about a week and it started to continuously fall off. I used it as directed. I hung voile sheers from it and it was adhered to glass which is one of the materials it supposed to stick to. This is just aggravation. I wish I could return this but I threw out the packaging.
